source: Built-in sklearn Digits/Wine/Breast Cancer with derived or partitioned pseudo-views; no natural independent modalities
fit: all feature preprocessing, denoisers, score predictors, PCA and kmeans centroids on train only
contrast: each score intervention applied to BOTH train and held-out test; shuffled only among available rows
oracle: feature-preservation oracle uses uncorrupted held-out TEST features; diagnostic and NONDEPLOYABLE
no_label_use: labels used for stratified split design and held-out ARI/NMI reporting, not fitting
status: exploratory post-hoc after prior Digits/Wine/Breast Cancer results
limitations: overlapping split records and no new naturally multi-view datasets; not independent confirmation
